sources.title: nemotron-ocr-v2: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview nemotron-ocr-v2 is a production-ready end-to-end optical character recognition model that detects text regions, recognizes transcribed text, and analyzes document layout through three jointly trained neural components: a RegNetX-8GF detector, a pre-norm Transformer recognizer, and a relational model for reading order analysis.
